Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 19. октобар ст. ст., „Св. пророк Јоил.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «пророк» is the `prophet` grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form; the heading gives him no epithet, and the patronymic «син Ватуилов» is in the body and is not part of the name the calendar prints. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «El a viețuit mai înainte de nașterea Domnului nostru Iisus Hristos cu 800 de ani» — he lived eight hundred years before the birth of Christ. The interval is the century that reading allows.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 октября ст. ст. — «Прор. Иоиля (800 до Р.Х.).»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry is the same prophet: one of the twelve called the lesser prophets, son of Bathuel, of the tribe of Reuben — «αυτό όμως δεν είναι σαφές, διότι άλλοι τον θέλουν καταγόμενο από την φυλή Γαδ», which the page says is not clear, others making him of the tribe of Gad — who prophesied when Joash was king over the tribe of Judah, «(878 - 838 π.Χ)», and who died in peace. **No `dates` proposed**: the years the page gives are the king's reign and not the prophet's, and the folder already carries its own interval. The page closes by distinguishing him from another: «άλλος είναι ο προφήτης Ιωήλ που τη μνήμη του γιορτάζουμε την 30η Μαρτίου» — the Joel kept on 30 March is a different man, which is the reader's report's business and not a second row here. The Ἀπολυτίκιον is taken and it names him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.11.2026 (19. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. пророк Јоил.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, one person, quoted whole with the closing full stop the Prologue prints (BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4). «пророк» is the `prophet` this folder already holds, so `types` is untouched. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND THE BOOK AGREES WITH THEM. The folder holds `death` -850 to -750, «c. 800 BC»; this entry says «Живео на 800 година пре Христа», he lived 800 years before Christ, which is the midpoint of the interval already recorded and narrows nothing. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. He is THE SECOND IN ORDER OF THE MINOR PROPHETS; he was THE SON OF ВАТУИЛ and OF THE TRIBE OF REUBEN — neither of which the other three books read for this folder gives, and the patronymic is the book’s own spelling and is left as it is printed. He prophesied THE AFFLICTION OF ISRAEL AND THE BABYLONIAN CAPTIVITY for the sins the people had committed before the Lord; he called the people TO A FAST and the priests TO WEEPING PRAYERS OF REPENTANCE, and the entry quotes him for it — «Наредите пост и вапијте ка Господу. Између тријема и олтара нека плачу свештеници.» And it names four more things he foretold: THE DESCENT OF THE HOLY SPIRIT ON THE APOSTLES, the pouring out of the grace of God’s Spirit ON ALL CHRISTIANS, THE DREAD JUDGEMENT OF GOD, which he described, and THE GLORY OF THE HOLY CHURCH OF GOD. No `office`, no `locations`, no `related` — the tribe and the father are named and no folder read here is either. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Јоил». The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day’s verse is Bishop Nikolai’s own.

hymns.text: A prorocului Tău, Doamne, Ioil pomenire prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm: mântuieşte sufletele noastre!

english.text: Keeping the memory of Thy prophet Joel, O Lord, through him we entreat Thee: save our souls!

hymns.text: Ὡς ἔμπνουν κειμήλιον, τῶν ἱερῶν ἀρετῶν, Προφήτης θεόληπτος, ὤφθης σοφέ, Ἰωήλ, ἑλλάμψει τοῦ Πνεύματος· ὅθεν τῆς εὐσέβειας, ἡ πηγὴ ὡς προέφης, ἔβλυσε τοὶς ἐν κόσμῳ, ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Κυρίου ἧς νῦν καταπολαύοντες, πόθω τιμῶμεν σε.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’. Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the only hymn on the page of «Προφήτης Ιωήλ», and it names him.

english.text: As a living treasure of the sacred virtues you were seen, wise Joel, a prophet caught up by God in the shining of the Spirit; and so, as you foretold, the fountain of godliness welled up out of the house of the Lord for those in the world — and we, who now enjoy it, honour you with longing.

hymns.text: Предведый Божие пришествие во плоти/ и наитие Духа Святаго и грядущий Суд предсказавый,/ пророче Иоиле,/ спасай молитвами твоими// чтущия тя от всех скорбей.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь пророка Иоиля»

english.text: Foreknowing God's coming in the flesh, and foretelling the descent of the Holy Spirit and the Judgement to come, O prophet Joel: save by your prayers from every sorrow those who honour you.

hymns.text: Просветившееся Духом чистое твое сердце/ пророчества бысть светлейшаго приятилище:/ зриши бо, яко настоящая, далече сущая,/ сего ради тя почитаем, пророче, блаженне Иоиле, славне.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак пророка Иоиля»

english.text: Your pure heart, enlightened by the Spirit, became the dwelling of the brightest prophecy, for you behold things far off as though they stood before you. Therefore do we honour you, O prophet, blessed and glorious Joel.
